scope: Pokemon species 1-386; Generation III historical reference only; never auto-add shop or combat cards.

sources.historical_policy: PokeAPI past generation_id is the final generation for an old snapshot. For target generation 3 choose the earliest past snapshot with generation_id >= 3; if absent use current values. This restores pre-Fairy types and Generation III stat values.
sources.evolution: Direct evolves_from_species_id relationships, filtered to species 1-386
sources.learnset: PokeAPI Emerald version_group_id 6 level-up moves, generation <= 3. level_up_pokeapi uses PokeAPI move IDs and identifiers; do not interpret them as PokeTactics runtime move IDs.
